ns2:course.label: Approaches to Language Diagnostics and Clinical Reasoning
ns2:course.description: Advanced study of concepts in evaluation and diagnosis of language disorders in children and adolescents, with a particular emphasis on critical thinking about current assessment methods and the development of clinical reasoning. 2 to 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 2 to 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
